rows.text: When riding in a group, it is prudent not to ride side by side, leaving each rider room to maneuver and react.
evidence: https://msf-usa.org/documents/library/group-riding/ — Group Riding: evitare la formazione affiancata perché riduce lo spazio di sicurezza.

rows.text: Riding side by side in the same lane reduces room to maneuver. In a group, it is prudent not to ride abreast.
evidence: https://msf-usa.org/documents/library/group-riding/ — Group Riding: evitare la formazione affiancata perché riduce lo spazio di sicurezza.

rows.text: For two-wheeled mopeds, the ban on being towed also applies when riding in a group: the vehicle ahead cannot pull the one behind.
evidence: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627 — art. 170, commi 1 e 4: il divieto di trainare o farsi trainare riguarda i conducenti dei veicoli a due ruote indicati al comma 1.

rows.text: Riding in a group does not permit exceeding speed limits: each rider must obey them and adjust speed to the conditions.
evidence: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627 — artt. 141 e 142: velocità adeguata e limiti.

rows.text: A different moped may have unfamiliar controls and handling. Get to know it before tackling demanding situations.
evidence: https://msf-usa.org/start-your-ride/basic-ridercourse/ — Motorcycle Familiarization: identificare comandi e caratteristiche.

rows.text: Braking response can vary from one vehicle to another: on an unfamiliar moped, you need to become familiar with the effectiveness of its brakes and the force needed.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5fa19888e90e07042c1e10f0/Transaidetal-2020-InstructorsManualCBCMotorcycleRiderTraining-Generic-AfCAP-RAF2114A-190524__1_.pdf — sezione 11.5, Emergency stopping: le prestazioni dei freni variano tra veicoli e con manutenzione e regolazione; consiglia di esercitarsi per conoscerne efficacia e forza necessaria, soprattutto su un mezzo sconosciuto.

rows.text: Mopeds can respond differently to steering. Without knowing how a new vehicle responds, you may misjudge your path through a turn. Get familiar with it in a controlled area.
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/road-safety/motorcycles — Practice Operating Your Motorcycle: i motocicli differiscono per maneggevolezza e risposta; familiarizzare con un mezzo sconosciuto in area controllata.

rows.text: Practicing in a safe, low-traffic place lets you learn the controls, braking and steering without immediately facing heavy traffic.
evidence: https://msf-usa.org/do-it-yourself-practice-drills/ — esercizi in parcheggio per familiarizzare con il mezzo.

rows.text: The controls of an unfamiliar vehicle can respond differently even before riding. Get familiar with the throttle and brakes without waiting until maximum speed.
evidence: California DMV, Motorcycle Driver Handbook, printed pages 11–12 (PDF pages 16–17), Get Familiar With the Motorcycle Controls: on an unfamiliar motorcycle, work the throttle, clutch and brakes before riding because controls react differently; then accelerate gently and turn slowly. https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/file/motorcycle-driver-handbook-pdf/

rows.text: Trying a different moped does not exempt the rider from wearing a helmet: while riding, an approved helmet must be worn and fastened. Exemptions apply to three- or four-wheeled mopeds with enclosed bodywork and to two- or three-wheeled mopeds with a crash-resistant safety cell, restraint systems and safety devices as required by the regulations.
evidence: https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-171/ — art. 171, commi 1 e 1-bis: obbligo del casco omologato e allacciato durante la marcia; esenzioni per veicoli a tre o quattro ruote con carrozzeria chiusa e per ciclomotori a due o tre ruote con cellula di sicurezza a prova di crash, sistemi di ritenuta e dispositivi di sicurezza secondo il regolamento.

rows.text: Getting familiar with the vehicle does not justify exceeding limits. Mopeds are designed for a maximum speed of no more than 45 km/h; any lower limits also apply.
evidence: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627 — artt. 52 e 142: velocità massima per costruzione dei ciclomotori e limiti stradali.

rows.text: The normal riding position keeps hands on the handlebars and feet on the supports to control the vehicle and maintain balance. One hand may be temporarily released when needed to maneuver or signal.
evidence: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627 — art. 170, comma 1: posizione corretta e uso delle mani sul manubrio, salvo la temporanea necessità di manovrare o segnalare.

https://msf-usa.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/motorcycle-operator-manual.pdf — Motorcycle Safety Foundation, Motorcycle Operator Manual, 18th edition, Basic Vehicle Control, Body Position, Feet, p. 10: piedi sugli appoggi per mantenere equilibrio e vicinanza ai comandi.

rows.text: A stable position, with hands and feet ready to operate the controls, helps maintain balance and control.
evidence: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627 — art. 170, comma 1: posizione e controllo; https://msf-usa.org/start-your-ride/basic-ridercourse/ — Motorcycle Familiarization: postura.

rows.text: The riding position must allow the rider to sit correctly and maintain control. Standing up while riding compromises this position.
evidence: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627 — art. 170, comma 1: posizione corretta e pieno controllo.

rows.text: Zigzagging is not a proper way to be noticed. Maintain a steady path and signal necessary maneuvers.
evidence: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627 — artt. 140 e 154: non creare pericolo e segnalare le manovre.

rows.text: Holding a phone distracts the rider and removes a hand from the controls. Do not use a handheld phone while riding.
evidence: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627 — art. 170, comma 1, e art. 173, comma 2: controllo del manubrio e divieto di uso manuale del telefono.

rows.text: Meeting an oncoming moped does not call for sounding the horn. Use it sparingly for road safety, not as a greeting.
evidence: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627 — art. 156, commi 1 e 2: segnalazioni acustiche moderate e per sicurezza.

rows.text: If the vehicle ahead is slow to move off, waiting allows time to resume without causing risky maneuvers or unnecessary noise.
evidence: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627 — artt. 140 e 156: prudenza e uso moderato del clacson.

rows.text: The horn is for safety and must be used sparingly; a short delay moving off does not justify repeated honking.
evidence: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627 — art. 156, commi 1 e 2: uso moderato per sicurezza.

rows.text: A signal to proceed does not make an improper overtake safe. Before any maneuver, check that it will not endanger or obstruct others.
evidence: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627 — artt. 148 e 154: condizioni del sorpasso e sicurezza delle manovre.

rows.text: Repeatedly honking to hurry the driver ahead is improper. Use the horn sparingly for road safety.
evidence: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627 — art. 156, commi 1 e 2: uso moderato per sicurezza.

rows.text: Do not make a U-turn at or near an intersection to get around a stopped vehicle. Wait and choose only permitted, safe maneuvers.
evidence: https://www.normattiva.it/eli/id/1992/05/18/092G0306/CONSOLIDATED/20240627 — art. 154, commi 1 e 6: sicurezza delle manovre e divieto di inversione presso le intersezioni.

rows.text: Injury or damage to people, animals or property caused by a vehicle in circulation can lead to compensation. Proof that the driver did everything possible to prevent the damage overcomes the presumption against the driver in the first paragraph of article 2054; liability remains, however, for damage caused by construction defects or inadequate maintenance.
evidence: https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/eli/gu/2005/08/31/202/so/148/sg/pdf — nota all’art. 40, art. 2054 c.c., commi 1 e 4, p. 39 del PDF: prova liberatoria del conducente per il danno da circolazione; responsabilità in ogni caso per danni da vizi di costruzione o difetto di manutenzione.

rows.text: The owner need not be present: the owner is jointly liable with the driver. Proof that the vehicle was used against the owner’s will overcomes the liability provided for in the third paragraph of article 2054; liability remains, however, for damage caused by construction defects or inadequate maintenance.
evidence: https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/eli/gu/2005/08/31/202/so/148/sg/pdf — nota all’art. 40, art. 2054 c.c., commi 3 e 4, p. 39 del PDF: responsabilità solidale del proprietario e prova della circolazione contro la sua volontà; responsabilità in ogni caso per danni da vizi di costruzione o difetto di manutenzione.

rows.text: Civil liability is intended to make good the harm suffered by the injured party: the person liable must compensate for it. The law allows the driver to prove that they did everything possible to avoid the damage.
evidence: https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/eli/gu/2005/08/31/202/so/148/sg/pdf — nota all’art. 40, testo dell’art. 2054 c.c.: comma 1, danno da circolazione e prova liberatoria del conducente; comma 3, responsabilità solidale del proprietario e prova della circolazione contro la sua volontà.

issues.reason: The cited Massachusetts motorcycle manual returned HTTP 403, so its cited page 16 and exact supporting point could not be independently inspected. Replace or supplement it with an accessible precise source, such as MSF Motorcycle Operator Manual, https://msf-usa.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/motorcycle-operator-manual.pdf, Basic Vehicle Control, Body Position, Feet, which supports feet on footrests for balance.

The statement that proving all possible precautions can avoid liability under article 2054 is overbroad: the cited article also provides liability in every case for damage from construction defects or inadequate maintenance (fourth paragraph). Limit the exculpation explicitly to the first-paragraph presumption, without implying immunity from all liability under article 2054.

The unqualified exception that the owner escapes joint liability by proving circulation against their will overlooks article 2054 fourth paragraph, which also provides liability in every case for damage from construction defects or inadequate maintenance. Qualify the third-paragraph exception in light of that provision.
